# moodle-cli 0.7.0-alpha.7

This prerelease fixes the sign-in hang reported on Node.js 22.12, makes an
expired remote session visible within minutes instead of half an hour, and
corrects managed deployment bookkeeping around rollbacks.

## Fixed in alpha.7

- Fail in seconds with the actual fix when the Node.js runtime has no `node:sqlite`. Browser cookies are read through that module, which Node only ships unflagged from 22.13, so on older runtimes every cookie read failed, the warning did not look like an access problem, and `moodle mcp login` opened a browser and then waited two minutes for a cookie it could never read. The supported Node.js floor is now 22.13; Bun is unaffected.
- Verify the remote Moodle session against Moodle before deciding whether it needs renewal. Readiness previously reported only the last scheduled keepalive touch, so a session ended from Moodle's own "Browser sessions" page kept reporting a healthy state for up to thirty minutes while every MCP client failed.
- Stop the background renewal job from re-uploading the session cookie it just read from the local cache, which is usually the cookie that has died. It now validates a fresh browser cookie instead, and reports the Worker's rejection code when one is refused.
- Explain why an unattended renewal could not sign in, and record the macOS renewal job's output under `~/Library/Logs`, so a job that never renews leaves evidence behind.
- Read the newest Wrangler deployment as production instead of the first one listed, keep the deployment receipt honest after a rollback, always re-release after a rollback, and upload Worker secrets with the version instead of through a separate deployment that Cloudflare refuses once a rollback is in place.

## Session renewal on macOS

The remote Worker keeps its own Moodle session alive and has run for months without intervention. It is the local job that cannot recover on its own: launchd starts it outside the browser's privacy scope, so it cannot read browser cookies to replace a dead session. On macOS the renewal job detects the failure and notifies; recovery is one `moodle mcp login`.

## Validation

- Typechecking, the full Node test suite, the packaged CLI smoke test, and the CLI/Worker build all pass.
- The deployment, rollback, token rotation, session renewal, and bridge paths were re-verified end to end against a live managed deployment, including a Moodle session ended from Moodle's own session management page.

The `alpha` npm dist-tag moves to this release. The stable `latest` dist-tag remains on `0.6.0`.
